full: 24 jams, or just 6. In a 2000 study, shoppers were more likely to buy from a table of 6 jams than from 24. But a review of 50 experiments found the average effect was nearly zero. It depends, overload grows when options are hard to compare. So make choosing easy. Group your options and say who each one is for. Like for kids, for cheese boards, for baking.
